aerial._doc: ledger 0097 round 4 (item 3): both layouts' aerial, source/road_wear/make_aerial_mosaic.py -> naip_2023_hp_mosaic.png (4495 x 2475 px, its record naip_2023_hp_mosaic.json): the 0.3 m crop below (its pixels unchanged, the same lattice carried north by whole rows) and, above it, the z18 photos of the same NAIP item (0.46 m: tracks/high-plains/source/naip_2023_hp_z18.png and source/full/naip_2023_hp_north_z18.png, public domain) within 40 m [invented extent] of the north loop, bilinear, registered against the crop where both hold a pixel: shift [0.0, 0.0] m (NCC 0.8948), luminance ratio 0.999 (not applied). Round 3's bake had no photo over about 800 of the north loop's 1,001 m and filled its tone flat from the nearest photographed asphalt. Was (0.1.7-0.1.11): USDA NAIP 2023-09-28, co_m_3910317_ne_13_030_20230928_20240104 (public domain), the 0.3 m crop ledger 0081 measured the kerbs off (tools/naip_crop.py, md5 4da61327; its record naip_2023_030_hp.json beside it): 4495 x 1202 px, 0.300 x 0.300 m, corners [W, N, E, S] exact (EPSG:4326 crop). It covers the whole lap: 0 of 3,205 centreline stations +-10 m fall outside it or on a black pixel

kerbs._doc: ledger 0081's 20 traced kerb runs (tools/author_kerbs_blend.py, 1KERB_circuit_<k>: blue / white kerbs and blue / yellow paint stripes, kerb_atlas_hp.png): 18 of them lie partly over the lane (data/kerbs.built.json in_vs_ribbon_edge_m < 0) at their measured offsets, where the line's tyres run. Each face takes the photo's measured darkening at its centroid's signed offset from the line (rubber 'photo'), to one of 16 copies of its own paint (copy k = paint x (1 - k x the measured peak / 15)), its u moved into that copy (v, the stripes, untouched); the material row is the exporter's own (ksPerPixel, no VAR) with txDiffuse -> the levelled paint. 16 levels [invented]: a 1.5 % step
